text: Coffee with Freya. She's 20 weeks now, scan went fine, and they've decided not to find out the sex. Her partner Gabriel is painting the nursery over half term. Due date is 3rd of March. Her mum wants to fly over from Oslo for the birth, which Freya is not sure about at all. Gabriel's sister Demi has offered to lend them all her old baby stuff.
Luis and Adriana finally got the keys to the place in Leeds! Moving 14 November. Need to send them a housewarming card once they're in.

Long call with Naledi. Her sister Lindiwe had the baby on Saturday, a little girl called Zola, 3.2kg. Naledi's flying to Joburg sometime next week to help out for a fortnight. She's nervous about the flight with her back the way it is. Remind me to message her before she goes.

Dimitri says the christening for baby Theo is on 7th of December at St Mary's, and he's asked me to be godfather. Owen and his wife are coming up from Bristol for it. I should sort a gift, maybe a silver cup.
Fang viewing two flats in Manchester end of the month. She hates the commute from Stockport so it's Ancoats or nothing apparently.

Pieter's leaving for Rotterdam early March, new job at the port authority. His girlfriend Kalani is staying here till the summer to finish her course. They seem fine about it but he said he's dreading the long distance bit.

Catch-up with Demi. Her brother Jack and his wife Laila are expecting twins in May. Demi is over the moon, already knitting. Their mum's moving in with them over the summer to help. Jack is apparently already researching double buggies and has a spreadsheet. Laila just wants to sleep. I should get them something for the shower.
Duc mentioned he's thinking about leaving London altogether. Probably Glasgow. Nothing decided.

Teresa's due date got moved to 22/01 after the last scan. She's been really struggling with sickness, can barely work some days. Her husband Paolo is doing everything at home. Must check in with her next week. She mentioned she misses proper Italian food from home, so maybe I take something round from the deli on Via Roma when I go.
Chen and Wei have put an offer in on the terraced house near the park. Hear back by Friday. Chen's mum is lending them part of the deposit, which Wei is a bit awkward about.
Gabriel's new nickname for the bump is Peanut. Freya pretends to hate it.
Patrick rang. The move to Cork is off, his company pulled the transfer. He's staying put and honestly sounded relieved. His dog Biscuit would've hated the ferry anyway.

Don't forget to drop the casserole round to Ifeoma's on Thursday. Baby Chidi is two weeks old and she's running on no sleep. Her husband Yusuf is back at work Monday, so she'll be on her own from then.
Thabo and Andile are moving into their first flat together on 1st of February. Thabo wants a decent coffee machine for it, kept going on about one with a milk frother. Gift idea for the housewarming.
Emil passed his driving test! Third attempt. Now he says he'll drive us all to Felix's leaving do in Edinburgh on 15 Dec.
Need to book the van for my move. Saturday 9th of November ideally, morning slot. Also cancel the broadband.

Reggie told me his daughter Joy is starting nursery in January and he's in bits about it. His wife Teresa has gone back to work full time so it's a big change for all of them. I should ask him how the settling-in sessions go.

Saw Louis at the school gate. Their new baby boy arrived on 30th September, called him Remy. Louis looks wrecked but happy. His partner Andile had a C-section and is still sore, recovering slowly. Their older girl keeps trying to pick the baby up. Remind me to drop off some meals sometime next week and to text Andile to see how she's healing.
Adriana says Luis keeps sending her Rightmove links at 2am. They want something with a garden for the dog, a lurcher called Pepa.
Laila is coeliac, so for the baby shower food on 12 April make sure there's a proper gluten free option.
Kalani's brother Joe is moving to Lisbon over the summer for a remote job. She's sad but planning to visit in September.

Flat viewing with Owen went badly. Damp in the bathroom, landlord wouldn't answer anything straight. He's got another one Tuesday in Clifton. His sister Freya has offered to come along this time because he never asks the right questions. Rent's going up everywhere, he said, and he's starting to wonder whether he should just stay with his parents until the spring.

Dimitri and his wife Fang just found out they're expecting again! Due early June. Fang's mum is thrilled, Dimitri is quietly panicking about space. They'll probably have to move out of the two-bed by the end of the year. Send congrats card. Also their little one, Sofia, starts reception in September, so a move mid-year would mean finding a new school too. Fang already sounds exhausted about it.
Felix: moving to Edinburgh 3rd of January, has a flat in Leith sorted. Starts at the university the week after. His partner Emil follows in March once his notice period is done.
Bumped into Mrs O'Brien. Her granddaughter's christening is next Sunday, and she's making the cake herself, four tiers. She's 82.

Pieter Wright called about the house sale. Completion slipped again, now end of the month at the earliest. He's sleeping badly and stressed about losing the buyer on the new place. Must call him Friday.
Ifeoma loves anything lemon. Hates coriander. Note for when I cook for her.
Quick one: Wei's sister Chen Wang is a midwife at the Royal, might be worth asking her about the antenatal classes for Demi.
Yusuf says the new house in Sheffield is finally done. Kitchen fitted last week, they're having people round on 23 Nov. His brother Andile is doing the barbecue, in November, madness.

Caught up with Joy over lunch. She and Reggie are looking at moving back to Durban sometime next year, to be near her parents now her dad's not well. He had a fall in August and her mum is struggling to cope on her own. Joy flies out 2nd of December for three weeks to sort things. I should check in with her when she's back, mid to late December.
Gabriel's sister Demi had her twelve week scan on Monday, all fine, so they've told the family. Due 14/05. Gabriel is going to be an uncle and won't stop talking about it.

Big week. Paolo and Teresa's baby arrived early, Wednesday night, a boy, Matteo. Both doing well. Paolo sent a photo at 4am. Hospital till the weekend. Don't forget to send flowers, and ask Teresa when they're up for visitors, maybe end of next week.
Reggie's mum is moving into sheltered housing in Hove on 6th of January. He's taking the week off to help clear her house.
Note to self: renew passport before the trip, it runs out in April. Sometime next week at the latest.
Uncle Patrick's 70th is the 18th of January, and Auntie Joy wants everyone in Galway for it. I'm driving my mum over the day before. He's been hinting at a new fishing reel, the fancy carbon one.
Naledi's back from Joburg. Lindiwe and the baby are doing well, though Lindiwe's struggling a bit with feeding. Naledi said Zola's christening will be over Easter, probably 5th April.

Lunch with Laila. She and Jack have put their flat on the market because twins won't fit in a one-bed. Viewings start this weekend. Laila's tired, 28 weeks, ankles like balloons. Jack's boss has said he can work from home from March. Remind me to ask Laila how the viewings went.
Fang moved into the Ancoats flat on Saturday. Loves it. Neighbour has a cat called Pickle that keeps wandering in.
Owen Baker, aka Bakes, has a new job in Cardiff from 2nd of February. He and his wife are house hunting there sometime next month. She's six months pregnant, so timing is tight.
Chen and Wei got the house! Offer accepted Friday. Completion hopefully end of January. Need to send them something, Wei's into plants so maybe a big fiddle leaf fig.
Rang Duc back. His wife Kalani had a miscarriage last week. He's not okay, she's worse. Doesn't want visitors yet. I'll message him on Sunday just to see how they're doing.

Joe and Ifeoma, the baby's due late February. Joe's mum is coming from Lagos for six weeks over the birth. Ifeoma loves her but six weeks is a lot, she said, laughing. They've just started the nursery.
Teresa said Paolo's dad passed away on Tuesday. Funeral is 4th of November in Naples. They're flying out with the baby on the 1st. I should send a card to Paolo before they leave.
Got home, ordered the cot sheets for the spare room. Painters booked for the 28th.
Thabo's flat-warming was cancelled, the landlord found asbestos. They're in temporary housing till early March.
Emil's grandmother is 100 on 12 December. The whole family's going to Copenhagen for it. He's got to give a speech in Danish and is terrified.

Talked to Adriana for ages. She's pregnant! Eight weeks, so very early, but she wanted me to know because she's been so sick. Luis is being brilliant. Due sometime around mid-June. They're still hoping to move before the baby comes, Leeds or maybe Harrogate. Her mum doesn't know yet. Need to check in with her in a couple of weeks.
Felix keeps saying Edinburgh's freezing. He's joined a climbing gym though and loves it. Emil arrives 14 March.
Lindiwe MacDonald texted, she's moving back to the UK over the summer with the baby. Wants to look at schools near Naledi in Croydon. Naledi's thrilled.
Joy and Reggie's anniversary is 3rd of June, 25 years. Their son Yusuf is planning a surprise do. I've said I'll help with invitations.

Pieter's flat in Rotterdam fell through, so he's staying with a colleague for a few weeks. Kalani visiting him over Christmas, 20th to the 28th. Remind me to ask Pieter if he found anything by mid-December.
Laila's baby shower is the 12th of April, at Demi's. Jack's not allowed. Demi asked me to do the games.
Dentist moved to 14/11, 9:30. Also pick up the dry cleaning before Saturday.

Gabriel says Freya's waters broke this morning, two weeks early! Baby girl arrived 6pm, called Isla. Freya's exhausted but fine. They're home tomorrow. Gabriel's parents arrive from Porto on Sunday. Text Freya congrats tonight and organise a meal rota with Demi for sometime next week.
Dr Barros, Andile's consultant, said the scar is healing well. Andile has a follow-up 9th of December. Louis is taking her.
Duc and Kalani are moving to Glasgow early in the new year after all. A fresh start, he said. His cousin Thabo has a spare room for them while they look. I'm really glad.
Teresa's daughter Joy turns one on 22nd of January. Teresa is planning a small party at home, just family. Joy is obsessed with ducks, so a duck book or bath toy would go down well.
Paolo's back from Naples. He seems flat, quiet. Teresa says he isn't sleeping. Sunday lunch at theirs, 10th of November. Must bring something for the baby.
Dimitri asked if I can help him move on the 30th. Said yes. Fang's mum is having the kids that weekend.
Weather's awful. Did nothing all day, cleaned the oven.
